definitions.short: asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun)
definitions.full: H2203. zepheth זֶ֫פֶת noun feminine Isa 34:9 pitch (compare on formative Ol § 164 c ) Sta § 187 a. Word is Armenian according to Lag Arm. Stud. 1351, BN 219 ; on Egyptian derivatives compare Cook Speaker's Comm. i. 484 ; Arabic according to Frä 151 , if Shemitic, is Aramaic loan-word; see also Ethiopic Di 1068 ) — pitch: — וּבַזָּ֑פֶת בַחֵמָר וַתַּחְמְרָה Exod 2:3 of ark of bulrushes; Isa 34:9 a לְגָפְרִ֑ית וַעֲפָרָהּ לְזֶפֶת נְחָלֶיהָ וְנֶחֶפְכוּ , 34:9 b בֹּעֵרָֽה׃ לְזֶפֶת אַרְצָהּ והיתה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to liquify );
